subject: Credit note VEN042-0022 – claim timing
body:
Record: VEN042-0022
Finding: VEN042-0022 appears in GSTR-2B for 2025-10, not 2025-09.
Why: The supplier reported the invoice one return period late, so the Rs 1,721 credit can be claimed only in that month.
Entry to make: Claim the credit in the month it appears in GSTR-2B.
Amount involved: Rs 1,721
